cases_incident_order.name: cases_incident_order
cases_incident_order.value: "cases"."incident_end_at" IS NULL OR "cases"."incident_start_at" IS NULL OR "cases"."incident_end_at" >= "cases"."incident_start_at"

extraction_regions_span_bounds.name: extraction_regions_span_bounds
extraction_regions_span_bounds.value: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("extraction_regions"."text_span") = 'object' AND "extraction_regions"."text_span" ?& ARRAY['start','end'] AND ("extraction_regions"."text_span"->>'start') ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND ("extraction_regions"."text_span"->>'end') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN ("extraction_regions"."text_span"->>'start')::bigint >= 0 AND ("extraction_regions"."text_span"->>'end')::bigint > ("extraction_regions"."text_span"->>'start')::bigint ELSE false END

extraction_regions_bbox_bounds.name: extraction_regions_bbox_bounds
extraction_regions_bbox_bounds.value: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("extraction_regions"."bbox_json") = 'object' AND "extraction_regions"."bbox_json" ?& ARRAY['x','y','width','height'] AND ("extraction_regions"."bbox_json"->>'x') ~ '^-?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)$' AND ("extraction_regions"."bbox_json"->>'y') ~ '^-?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)$' AND ("extraction_regions"."bbox_json"->>'width') ~ '^-?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)$' AND ("extraction_regions"."bbox_json"->>'height') ~ '^-?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)$' THEN ("extraction_regions"."bbox_json"->>'x')::numeric >= 0 AND ("extraction_regions"."bbox_json"->>'y')::numeric >= 0 AND ("extraction_regions"."bbox_json"->>'width')::numeric > 0 AND ("extraction_regions"."bbox_json"->>'height')::numeric > 0 AND ("extraction_regions"."bbox_json"->>'x')::numeric + ("extraction_regions"."bbox_json"->>'width')::numeric <= 1 AND ("extraction_regions"."bbox_json"->>'y')::numeric + ("extraction_regions"."bbox_json"->>'height')::numeric <= 1 ELSE false END

timeline_precision_timestamp_consistent.name: timeline_precision_timestamp_consistent
timeline_precision_timestamp_consistent.value: CASE WHEN "timeline_events"."precision" = 'UNKNOWN' THEN "timeline_events"."occurred_at" IS NULL WHEN "timeline_events"."precision" = 'DATE_ONLY' THEN "timeline_events"."occurred_at" IS NOT NULL AND "timeline_events"."occurred_at" = (date_trunc('day', "timeline_events"."occurred_at" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') ELSE "timeline_events"."occurred_at" IS NOT NULL END
